name: Get full step output from instance
description: Get full step output from instance Retrieves the full, untruncated output for a specific step on a workflow instance. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workflows/{workflow_name}/instances/{instance_id}/step
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workflows/{workflow_name}/instances/{instance_id}/step
Retrieves the full, untruncated output for a specific step on a workflow instance. Returns a flat status-shaped JSON body with step `status` ('running' | 'waiting' | 'complete' | 'errored'), `error` (nullable), and `output` (the step value, or null while running/waiting/errored). When the step returned a ReadableStream from step.do, the response is served as 'application/octet-stream' with the raw bytes as the body instead of JSON. A `status='running'` response with non-null `error` indicates the step is currently retrying after a prior attempt failed.
Required: workflow_name (path); instance_id (path) — Instance identifier. User-created instances match `^[a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9-_]*$` (max 100 characters); cron-triggered instances can use a longer, system-generated id derived from the cron expression.; name (query) — Exact step name from the instance logs response, including the generated counter suffix.; type (query) — Step type to disambiguate step.do and waitForEvent entries that share the same name.; account_id (path)
Optional: attempt (query) — Specific attempt number to retrieve output or error for.
